name: STI Co., Ltd.
summary: STI Co., Ltd. is a South Korean manufacturer specializing in equipment for the semiconductor industry. The company offers a range of sophisticated chemical management solutions, such as central chemical supply systems, slurry mixing setups, and specialized chemical mixing/dilution systems designed for compounds like TMAH, KOH, HF, NH4OH, and SC-1. Their product portfolio also encompasses various wet process stations, covering applications like initial processing, pre-deposition, pre-photo stages, and ITO. Furthermore, STI provides an array of cleaning technologies, including cassette cleaners, after-glass grinding cleaners, photo mask developers, and specialized cleaners for fine metal, screen masks, and back-side glass. They also supply developers, glass slimming systems, strippers, and etchers. Beyond these, their offerings extend to advanced inkjet printing systems, as well as reflow and wet blast systems. Established in 1997, STI Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Anseong, South Korea.
